# SECTION I — ELAI exhaustive super feature list (compiled)

## System: I — Feature engineering over wiring bedrock (Tracks 12–20: fault isolation, evidence-ranked search, cache economics, deterministic gates, routing/budgets, open-weight flywheel, deterministic-over-prompt, design critique/trust, competitor-steal ports)

Family I is the 54-session feature-engineering plan (I-1..I-54) plus I-0 index and grounding maps, authored after the wiring bedrock. Deep ledgers DEEP-I-001..006 and summary orientation `09-I-SUMMARY_INDEX` are merged here.

Status rule: deep ledgers and explicit CORRECT/SUPERSEDED/conflict markers beat the summary snapshot. Losing claims appear as **Superseded:** bullets with anchors. Status labels are plan-recorded unless an auditor independently verified.

Source (read-only): `docs/thefinalglance/feature-discovery/aggregates/I-AGGREGATE.md`.
